farmersdelight_client_tempt_goal_skip.conversion: @Inject HEAD (cancellable) of CommonEvents.onAnimalsJoinWorld: returns when the event's level is a client level; for a server level the listener runs unchanged. Exact variant: client copies of the tempted mobs carry no Farmer's Delight tempt goal (client goal selectors never run, goals are not synced). Runtime flag farmersdelightClientTemptGoalSkip. Helper bons.furious.patch.farmersdelight_coo49.ClientTemptSkip.
